newsitem.title: USA: Icahn sells RJR Nabisco stake - Goldman.
newsitem.headline: Icahn sells RJR Nabisco stake - Goldman.

text.p: Investor Carol Icahn sold his entire stake of 19.9 million shares of RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp last night, according to Goldman Sachs.
In a brief statement, Goldman said it traded the shares "off board last night," which means they were traded away from the New York Stock Exchange, where RJR is listed.
Goldman declined to say what the price was for the shares.
Icahn could not be reached immediately for comment.
Goldman sources said the shares were sold at 36-3/4.
RJR Nabisco shares fell 7/8 to 36-7/8 in opening trade on Thursday.
